datasets.description: Collection 3 Copernicus Global Land Service land-cover products from the public Digital Earth Africa distribution. datasets.valueInterpretation: Original UInt8 permanent-water cover fractions 0–100, not discrete land-cover classes, water-occurrence counts, optical reflectance or a daily observation. warnings: The current connector supports one layer within the CGLS land-cover product family and five actual publisher reference-year items. The requested area must be wholly within the finite published distribution bbox; outside or oversized selections fail rather than substituting another region, year or layer. The reference year and publisher STAC calendar interval describe the map release, not a single-year acquisition guarantee.
